# Thirugnana Sambandar

Songs that name the child saint Sambandar of Sirkazhi, or tell an episode of his life. In the Thiruppugazh tradition (and in the English commentary stored with each song) Murugan is said to have come into the world as Sambandar, so many songs simply say "You came as Thirugnana Sambandhar". The existing `shiva/stories/saints-sambandar.md` covers 20 songs of the Jain contest; this set widens it to the whole life.

## Files

- `STORIES.md` index, `by-song.md`, `song-story-map.txt`, `SOURCES.md`, `stories/<slug>.md` (one per story).
- Built by `scriptures/scripts/build_new_sets.py` (hand-written catalogue + generator); rerun it after editing the catalogue.
- Nothing here is bundled into the app or touches the DB.

## Method (research pass of 2026-11-10)

1. Keyword sweeps of the Tamil lyrics found almost nothing (names are split by sandhi), so the English commentary columns (`english_meanings_list`, `english_pathavurai`) were swept instead.
2. Each story lists songs from that sweep; each assignment is re-checked against the commentary when this script runs, and a Tamil lyric line is quoted where one matches.
3. Source locations come from web checks (see `SOURCES.md`); verse numbers are not machine-checked.

Assignments by confidence: t=57, c=120, low=0.

Assignments start KEYWORD-LEVEL: a song is listed when its English commentary (and, where possible, a Tamil lyric line) matches the story. A story with a 'Hand-read notes' section was then read (in full, or the doubtful part, as that section says) and wrong songs removed; other stories were not. Confidence: **t** = a Tamil lyric line matched and the commentary agrees; **c** = commentary only (no Tamil keyword line found); **low** = commentary did not match, check by reading the song.
